Are you Cyera-kind ?
Our Guiding Principle

Redefine “possible”

We’re constantly breaking past limits, questioning the status quo, and turning what-if into what’s next.

Our values

Push Boundaries

Finding smarter, faster, and more creative ways to solve problems and achieve what others think can’t be done.

The Customer Compass

Guiding every decision by customer needs, driving success by delivering meaningful value.

Own and Act

Taking responsibility, acting decisively, and taking ownership to overcome obstacles that drive purposeful results.

Elevate Together

We lift each other up with kindness, unity, and a spirit of a winning team. Inspired by Firgoon* – the unselfish joy in another’s success—we celebrate every win as a shared achievement.

*Firgoon  [FEER-goon] /ˈfɪərˌɡuːn/ noun

Genuine, unselfish delight or pride in the accomplishment of another person or teammate.

Our Benefits

You should love where you work

That’s why no matter where you are in your career, we give you everything you need to stay on your game, feel valued, and make a true impact.

Our Culture Manifesto

The Cyera way

We hire sharp minds and trust them to do what they do best. We move fast, not because we chase chaos, but because we remove friction. No micromanagement. Just ownership, accountability, and a bias for action. Curiosity drives us. We ask questions, challenge assumptions, and stay open to new ideas. Titles never dictate who gets to have a voice. Feedback is direct, egos are checked at the door, and learning never stops. We operate as one united team. We don't gate-keep. We share knowledge, own mistakes, and win together. We have one shared commitment to building something that matters.

At Cyera, culture isn’t a set of slogans. It’s how we work, how we think, and how we push each other to be better every day.
